query: WITH counts AS (SELECT 'exercises' AS key,count(*)::text AS value FROM public.exercises UNION ALL SELECT 'exercise_questions',count(*)::text FROM public.exercise_questions UNION ALL SELECT 'exercise_attempts',count(*)::text FROM public.exercise_attempts), columns AS (SELECT column_name || ':' || data_type AS value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='exercises' AND column_name IN ('chapter_id','lesson_id','exercise_type','difficulty','content_markdown','correction_markdown','is_published','is_active','estimated_duration_minutes','display_order','is_test_data') ORDER BY column_name), policies AS (SELECT policyname || ':' || cmd || ':' || coalesce(qual,'') || ':' || coalesce(with_check,'') AS value FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('exercises','exercise_questions','exercise_attempts') ORDER BY tablename,policyname), functions AS (SELECT proname || ':' || has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE')::text || ':' || has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE')::text AS value FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND proname IN ('can_access_exercise_for_current_student','get_my_exercise_catalog','get_my_exercise_detail','start_exercise_attempt','submit_exercise_attempt','get_my_exercise_attempt_result','get_my_exercise_history') ORDER BY proname) SELECT 'count' AS kind,key AS name,value FROM counts UNION ALL SELECT 'column','exercises',value FROM columns UNION ALL SELECT 'policy','module',value FROM policies UNION ALL SELECT 'function','module',value FROM functions ORDER BY kind,name LIMIT 100;
